evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/t/a imports and uses MessagePackMapper plus SnakeYAML Yaml, DumperOptions and LoaderOptions together with file/input/output primitives, fixing a shared configuration serialization/mapping role rather than a concrete definition loader.

The recovered source surface includes byte-array/output-stream, file writer/output stream, Files/OpenOption, Map/List and TypeReference machinery, consistent with bidirectional YAML/MessagePack config data loading and emission.

R247 DefinitionConfigLoader extends this exact class, and reviewed config loaders plus map/wandering-merchant loaders consume the same shared rs/t/a infrastructure; an exact-v308 asset probe independently validated the MessagePackMapper config path.

candidates.note: ConfigDataMapper is a conservative descriptive recovery for the shared YAML/MessagePack mapping utility beneath the v308 config-loader stack. It does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier. Confidence 0.995.
